description: Latest DEX swaps, newest first, for exactly one of: a token (`unit`), a pool (`poolId`) or a wallet (`address`). Each trade has the time, DEX, side (buy/sell of the base token), amounts in and out (decimal-adjusted), price in ADA, value in ADA and USD, the trader's stake address and the transaction hash.

address.description: Wallet (addr1…, stake1… or $handle): trades made by this wallet.

cursor.description: Value of `nextCursor` from the previous call, to get the next page.

limit.description: How many trades to return (1-50, default 10).

poolId.description: Pool id: trades in this pool.

unit.description: Token unit: trades of this token. Give exactly one of unit, poolId, address.

name: get_recent_trades
title: Recent DEX trades
